about: The code↔view boundary (#1879). "enforced": every reach across the boundary that exists today, exact per file — one more is a failure, one fewer is stale. "declared": files that convert between code and views in ways no structural rule can see; named and counted, not enforced. Both lists only shrink: each new enforced reach needs its own line, "added": { "<reach>": "#<issue> <why>" }, and a newly declared file needs "added": "#<issue> <why>". See boundary.ts.

enforced.why: Runs our reader on every evaluate (StrudelEngine.ts:1651) and stamps irNodeId on each hap from its index (:1620, :2524, :2611, and onTrigger via HapStream.ts:135). Breakpoints, the gutter and the IR inspector read that stamp. The id is a hash of the hap's own span, so the engine can compute it without our IR.
Imports the package subpath @stave/editor/trackId, a bundle entry built straight from codeView/ir/trackId.ts so the timeline can read a label without the barrel.

added.codeView/ir/trackId#labelAtOffset: #1921 reading a label moved into codeView; the timeline calls the owner through the subpath it already used, in place of its own regex

enforced.why: Imports the package subpath @stave/editor/trackId, the same barrel-free entry trackLabel.ts uses, so the timeline reads a section name with the rule a track label uses.

added.codeView/ir/trackId#sectionNameAt: #1921 the section reader was a second, ASCII-only copy of the name rule; it moved into codeView and the timeline calls it through the subpath

enforced.why: The engine reads the document to decide which track a bare statement's pattern belongs to: chunk detection, plus the track numbering in codeView/mixer/stripModel that the mixer joins on. It sits in the engine's runtime import graph, where importing the entry loads the mini-notation parser ahead of the engine test's mock and the suite dies at load.

added.codeView/mixer/stripModel#bareCaptureIdF: #1882 the engine already imported this file; it moved into the area in #1884, so the same dependency now crosses the boundary
added.codeView/mixer/stripModel#isTrackChunk: #1882 the engine already imported this file; it moved into the area in #1884, so the same dependency now crosses the boundary

enforced.why: Dead code: nothing has mounted this component since the editors became workspace compositions (32f0e33a) — no importer, not exported, not in the bundle. Its external sync (model.setValue when the code prop differs) therefore never runs. #1915 deletes the file and this entry with it. The live whole-document sync is EditorView's value prop, written by @monaco-editor/react itself, which no symbol rule can see (#1903).

added.door#monaco ITextModel.setValue: #1914 the door rule learned Monaco's own document writes; this call predates the rule and is the only one outside the writer

enforced.why: A line scanner needs only the label rule, which lives in the dependency-free leaf codeView/ir/trackId.ts (the file the app's @stave/editor/trackId subpath is built from, and which a test keeps import-free). Importing it through the entry pulls every codeView module into the engine's graph, and StrudelEngine.test then fails to load: a module evaluating @strudel/core at import time reaches the test's mock before it is initialised.

added.codeView/ir/trackId#LABEL_HEAD: #1921 the scanner's own copy of the identifier regex became the shared LABEL_HEAD; the entry route broke StrudelEngine.test's collection, so it reads the leaf
